seoTitle: Which season is best for your move? | Gérard & Fils
seoDesc: Spring, summer, autumn or winter: the pros, prices and availability of each season to plan your move in Brussels.
h1: Which season should you choose for your move?

intro.p: You have found the home of your dreams, but you are wondering when to organise your move? The season you choose can change a great deal: weather, prices, removal company availability, family organisation… in short, there is no single answer. Each period has its advantages and its little headaches. Here is an overview to help you decide.

body.p: Spring traditionally marks the start of the peak moving season. Temperatures turn mild again, the days get longer, and spring energy makes you want change. It is an ideal time if you want generally favourable weather without the overwhelming heat of summer.

On the other hand, “popular period” also means rising prices. Removal companies start to be in great demand, and diaries fill up fast. And beware of the notorious March showers and April rain: there is nothing worse than opening a damp box in your new living room.

sections.h: Summer: the star season… but at what price?

body.p: Summer is THE favourite season for moving. The children are on holiday, friends and family are more available, and the long days let you make steady progress without rushing. Moving in a T-shirt under a bright sun has more charm than moving in the snow, after all.

But there are two downsides: price and heat. It is the most expensive time of year, as demand soars. And carrying a sofa or a fridge in the middle of the afternoon at 30°C quickly becomes a sporting challenge. If you choose summer, it is best to book several months ahead and have plenty of cold water on hand.

September and October offer an excellent compromise. Prices drop after the summer rush, removal companies have more availability, and the weather stays fairly mild. You will often have more flexibility to choose the date that suits you.
The only drawback: the days get shorter, and carrying boxes in the dark or in light autumn rain is not always fun. But overall, autumn remains an attractive option.

sections.h: Winter: dare to try the low season

body.p: At first glance, moving in the depths of winter seems a strange idea. Cold, ice, short days… not very tempting. And yet, for those who want to save money, it is the ideal season. Prices are at their lowest and removal companies generally have much more availability.
With a little organisation (bringing gloves, protecting your belongings from damp, and checking road conditions), the difficulties immediately become more manageable.

sections.h: So which season should you choose?

body.p: It all depends on your priorities. A tight budget? Go for winter to get the best prices. Dreaming of sunshine and longer days? Opt for spring or summer. Looking for a balance between price and comfort? Autumn is probably the best option.

Whatever the time of year, preparation is what matters most: book your slot early enough, plan for the weather and organise your boxes in advance.
